workflow.task_summary: Normalize the uploaded SRA RunInfo TSV into a FASTQ sample sheet covering paired and single-end runs while preserving run, sample, layout, file-path, and organism fields, then validate the sample sheet.

steps.reason: Convert the archival RunInfo TSV into a normalized FASTQ sample sheet that keeps run, sample, layout, file-path, and organism fields for both paired and single-end runs.
Validate the normalized sample sheet before it is used by downstream FASTQ workflows, ensuring paired and single-end entries are well-formed.
